load_bearing_verifications.claim: TEMPO 3:4 reported hyperuricemia in 3.9% of tolvaptan recipients versus 1.9% with placebo and gout in 2.9% versus 1.4%.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: Current JYNARQUE label and Torres et al. 2012; PMID:23121377; DOI:10.1056/NEJMoa1205511

load_bearing_verifications.claim: The JYNARQUE pharmacodynamic record reports a reversible 20–25% decrease in uric-acid clearance and a 6–10% decrease in GFR.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: Current JYNARQUE label, Clinical Pharmacology section

load_bearing_verifications.claim: A one-week study in 20 people with ADPKD found that tolvaptan-induced serum-urate elevation resulted from decreased uric-acid clearance during aquaresis and lower GFR, without a significant renal-blood-flow change.

The PMDA TEMPO review reported combined gout/hyperuricemia in 6.7% versus 2.9%, clinically significant uric-acid increases in 6.2% versus 1.7%, reversal toward placebo after follow-up, and no severe, serious, or discontinuation events.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: PMDA ADPKD tolvaptan review report, section 3.(iii).B.(5).5

load_bearing_verifications.claim: REPRISE reported gout in 3.1% with tolvaptan versus 2.9% with placebo.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: FDA NDA 204441 medical review; corroborated by the Canadian JYNARQUE product monograph

load_bearing_verifications.claim: Collecting-duct intracellular urate is controlled by apical GLUT9b influx and ABCG2 efflux and can drive V2R-independent AQP2 accumulation through PDE4-mediated cAMP degradation and AMPK activation.
The SereNDIpity-pb1 study was open-label with 17 participants and reported a 30.2% mean reduction in 24-hour urine volume after probenecid was added to stable tolvaptan.
The six FAERS reports constitute six independent causal cases.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: Case-level openFDA records show that reports 26232487 and 26264173 share age, sex, event date, indication, dose, and event terms, while report 26363665 lists tolvaptan as concomitant with a start date after the event date.
load_bearing_verifications.status: unverified — no independent-case or causal inference retained

load_bearing_verifications.claim: The complete water-output, filtration, urate-clearance, collecting-duct transporter, genotype, and gout-risk system has been demonstrated in humans.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: No identified study measured the complete proposed system.
load_bearing_verifications.status: unverified — retained only as a Research Conjecture with a discriminating paired-data analysis

limitations: FAERS lacks a denominator and cannot establish incidence or causality; incomplete chronology and likely duplicate reporting weaken the original six-report packet.
TEMPO establishes a chronic high-dose ADPKD signal, but REPRISE did not reproduce a gout imbalance and short-course lower-dose SAMSCA evidence does not establish the same effect.
The measured tolvaptan effect localizes to reversible renal clearance and hemodynamics but does not isolate a single transporter or show that dehydration is necessary.
SereNDIpity-pb1 was small, open-label, and uncontrolled; probenecid is nonselective, so the human water-handling result cannot be assigned specifically to ABCG2.

The Hadla et al. corresponding investigator reports a patent interest in probenecid for ADPKD, and the investigator-initiated clinical study received Otsuka support; the paper states that the sponsor had no role in the study.
Regional searches were bounded and several database interfaces used broad matching or exposed only application shells; no universal absence claim was made.
No non-English source supplied a load-bearing claim, so the two-model translation protocol was not triggered.
